name: Applewood Orchard
tagline: Applewood Orchard Opens for the Season
description: Applewood Orchard is an agritourism farm in 702 Hamburg Avenue, MN, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
